policies: Keep every raw source row and its ordinal; do not deduplicate different positions by address ID.
Municipal certification is a source attribute, not an independent national completeness proof.
Address ranges are not expanded into assigned house numbers.
BAN street-name buckets are not physical-road inventories.
TIGER overlapping road-name features are not unique physical segments.
No delivery, occupant identity, building/room autofill or inferred number is produced.
